comment.narrative: Annual Progress Report 2021 page 8 Penguin Pepo saving lives in Armenia. Despite the demanding COVID19 pandemic a war in the territory of NagornoKarabakh as well as the threat of a coup dtat in 2021 the first EUDEIB integrated national communication campaign Safety is in your actions was implemented and delivered impactful results in Armenia. Despite numerous difficulties in May 2021 the campaign went live with a TV radio social media and outdoor promotion campaign across the country. In addition a road safety hour in all Armenian schools reaching 190000 pupils and an online webinar promoting road safety education was organized. This was the first nationwide mobilization activity of this kind in Armenia to date.As a result the Ministry of Education committed to using the webinar as a basis for a compulsory modulein primary and secondary schools dedicated to road safety. Its usage will continue in 2022 and beyond.The Facebook campaign delivered 19 million impressions and 6 million Video views in less than four months. Beyond the high level of awareness for the core messages the campaign also drove very strong consideration and engagement with a Video Completion Rate of 16 more than 55000 PostReactions and close to 10000 Post Shares.
